jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join the LKQ Family! We're looking for motivated individuals to join our team at LKQ Corporation. With opportunities for growth, competitive benefits, and a supportive work environment, LKQ is the place to be. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career!

Responsible for translating sales priorities into clear processes, tools, insights, and execution plans that improve field readiness, sales productivity, and revenue growth. Serves as a business partner to sales leadership and field teams, representing Sales on cross-functional initiatives and coordinating the development, rollout, and adoption of programs that strengthen commercial execution.

Salary:
$100,000 - $120,000 depending on experience. Essential Job Duties:
- Lead the development and execution of national sales campaigns, sales contests, service launches, and other strategic sales programs, including field readiness, supporting resources, communications, and follow-through.
- Partner with sales leadership and field teams to identify barriers, gather feedback, and translate business needs into practical process, tool, and program improvements.
- Gather and analyze customer feedback, Voice of the Customer (VOC) insights, and field input to identify trends, improve customer experience, and support commercial strategy and sales initiatives.
- Represent Sales on cross-functional projects and customer-impacting initiatives, communicating objectives, progress, risks, field needs, and next steps to key stakeholders.
- Develop sales playbooks, best practices, presentations, proposals, and field-facing resources that support consistent execution and customer readiness.
- Coordinate cross-functional support for new service launches, ensuring customer requirements, timelines, and sell-in readiness are met
- Support Salesforce adoption and improvement by defining field requirements, recommending enhancements, reinforcing best practices, and partnering with system owners on solutions that improve sales productivity.
- Monitor sales program participation, adoption, and results, using available data and field feedback to provide actionable recommendations and support ongoing problem solving.
- Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, IT, and other business partners to align priorities and execute sales initiatives that support growth and customer needs.
- Assume other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
- Not responsible for supervising employees.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
- 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales project or program management, sales operations, or related field.
- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and supporting field sales teams.
- Influence without authority, ability to work across function levels

Preferred Requirements:
- Experience supporting CRM adoption, sales process improvements, national sales programs, or service launches.
- Experience in automotive services, collision repair, or related industry.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
- Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
- Frequent use of Outlook, Word, Excel, graphics, etc.
- Regularly uses moderately complex oral and written skills. May train others in functional areas, interact with others, and make presentations to department or middle management.
- Problems encountered are routine, somewhat repetitive, and generally solved by following clear directions and procedures.
- Decisions generally affect own job or assigned functional area.
- Results are defined; sets personal own goals and determines how to achieve results with few or no guidelines to follow; supervisor/manager provides broad guidance and overall direction.
- Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously with moderate complexity.

Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment:
- Work is primarily sedentary: must be able to sit for extended periods of time and use a computer, keyboard, and mouse frequently.
- The employee must occasionally life and/or move up to 25 pounds.
- Travel may be required periodically, including overnight stays (contingent on position requirements).
- Moderate overnight travel (up to 25%)

Benefits:
- Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance plans
- No Saturday Work! Working Days are Monday - Friday.
- Up to 3 weeks Paid Time Off & 8 Paid Holidays
- 401(k) Retirement Plan w/ Match
- Company Paid Basic Life Insurance
- Paid Parental Leave
- Tuition reimbursement

Join us for an exciting career journey with positive, driven individuals.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join the LKQ Family! We're looking for motivated individuals to join our team at LKQ Corporation. With opportunities for growth, competitive benefits, and a supportive work environment, LKQ is the place to be. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career!

Starting pay $70-90K

Responsible for overseeing location performance, which encompasses various crucial aspects such as quality assurance, customer satisfaction, human resources, inventory management, safety, and gross margin. Play an active and supportive role in collaborating with all departments, including warehouse, distribution, and employee direction. Essential Job Duties
- Cultivate a culture among all employees that fosters the aspiration to deliver excellent customer service, treat customers with courtesy, and provide top-quality products.
- Coach and inspire capable staff members to achieve their best potential.
- Oversee and manage key performance indicators related to growth, productivity, and inventory control, ensuring efficient and cost-effective operations.
- Monitor and review plans and objectives for department.
- Responsible for managing and supervising all departments within the allocated budget and utilize Lean Daily Management to devise strategies for enhancing performance and grow efficiencies.
- Ensure adherence to all Federal, state, provincial, and local laws, statutes, regulations, as well as Company policies and procedures.
- Prioritize compliance with safety and environmental standards to maintain a secure and hazard-free workplace.
- Provide support for the ongoing enhancement of the business' quality improvement system.
- Assume other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

- Manage the work of others, including planning, assigning, scheduling and reviewing work, ensures quality standards. Responsible for hiring, terminating, training and developing, reviewing performance and administering corrective action for staff.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience
- High School Diploma/GED.
- 5 years+ in specialized profession or equivalent; Proficient in specialty including prior senior lead / supervisor experience.
- Must possess a valid driver’s license in order to operate a Company vehicle.
- Computer software training or knowledge.
- Prior experience that demonstrates effective supervision and leadership skills.

Preferred Requirements
- Bachelor's Degree.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities
- Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
- Frequent use of Outlook, Word, Excel, graphics, etc. Ability to create, maintain and incorporate functions into Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, databases, and Powerpoint presentations to support business objectives.
- Frequently communicates complex information across departments and interacts with management. Can present, resolve and address delicate situations. Can motivate and persuade others.
- Problems are varied and complex, requiring analysis or interpretation of the situation. Problems are solved using knowledge and skills, general precedents and practices.
- Decisions impact the management and operations within a department or business unit. May contribute to business and operational decisions that affect the department.
- Provides and sets goals and priorities for functional area. May make recommendations for department policies, practices, and programs. Makes decisions for and/or resolves problems for others.
- Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously with moderate complexity.

Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment
- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, reach, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or sit for extended periods of time.
- The employee may be exposed to hazardous situations, conditions, and equipment. Must be able to work in cramped spaces or underneath vehicles that may require getting into awkward positions. May regularly wear personal protective equipment (PPE). May be exposed to extreme temperatures and high noise levels.
- Travel may be required periodically, including overnight stays of approximately 30-35% or more.
- Must be able to lift up to 75 pounds.

Benefits:
- Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
- Paid Time Off
- Paid Parental Leave
- Fertility Coverage
- 401k with Generous Company Match
- Company Paid Life Insurance and Long-Term Disability
- Short-Term Disability
- Employee Assistance Program
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Employee Discounts
- PNC Daily Pay Option

Join us for an exciting career journey with positive, driven individuals.

jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Join the LKQ Family! We're looking for motivated individuals to join our team at LKQ Corporation. With opportunities for growth, competitive benefits, and a supportive work environment, LKQ is the place to be. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career!

As a part of our continued growth, LKQ is looking for a passionate and experienced General Manager to join Elitek Vehicle Services for our Austin and San Antonio market! To be successful in this role, one must have ample experience leading a team, creating and implementing strategies, and business-to-business sales. This position also includes full mechanical knowledge, reprogramming using factory equipment, and a large amount of electrical diagnostics. Air Bag diagnostic knowledge and replacement after vehicles have been in a collision, R/I dash and motors, and R/R front suspension parts and subframes are also required.

Compensation:
Salary: $70,000 - $85,000 annually, depending on experience
Essential Job Duties
- Hiring, training, and developing new Technicians

- Provide prompt and professional service to assigned customers.

- Provide mechanical and diagnostic procedures on most vehicle makes and models.

- Maintain current knowledge of new systems and techniques in the automotive industry, i.e. airbag systems, radar cruise control,

- forward collision warning, adaptive headlights, and so forth.

- Develop and maintain excellent customer relationships through the use of our company Core Values and Brand Promise.

- Assumes other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities
- As an area manager, you'll have overall responsibility for technicians in an allocated area.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience
- 7+ years of automotive repair experience.

- High School Degree (or GED equivalent).

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities
- Read wiring diagrams & diagnose vehicles.

- Possess and display a strong and healthy work ethic.

- Strong time management skills and detailed-oriented.

- Professional appearance and outgoing personality.

Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment
- Must be able to lift and carry up to 75 lbs. Work in a shop environment including heat and loud noise.

Preferred Qualifications:
Proficient use of a variety of automotive service and diagnostic equipment such as Moto Logic & Identifix.

Benefits:
- No Saturday Work! Working Days are Monday - Friday.

- Vacation & Paid Holidays

- Paid Parental Leave

- $5,000 Tuition Assistance

- Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance plans

- Company Paid Basic Life Insurance

- 401(k) Retirement Plan w/ Match

- Uniforms

- Company equipped Vehicle, Toll Tag, and Expense card.

- Provided Laptop, Phone, and internet hotspot.

- Generic and Manufacturer-specific dealer software and hardware.

- A variety of service-related mechanical equipment.

jobs.title: Real Estate Asset Manager
jobs.description:
Join the LKQ Family! We're looking for motivated individuals to join our team at LKQ Corporation. With opportunities for growth, competitive benefits, and a supportive work environment, LKQ is the place to be. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career!

Responsible for supporting LKQ North American real estate portfolio by managing transaction activities, maintaining portfolio information, and coordinating with internal stakeholders and external brokerage partners. Oversees the execution of lease transactions, portfolio reporting, and real estate systems while ensuring data accuracy, process consistency, and alignment with business objectives. The ideal candidate is organized, collaborative, and experienced in commercial real estate transactions, lease administration, and portfolio management. Essential Job Duties:
- Lead the end-to-end execution of commercial real estate transactions, including site acquisitions, lease renewals, relocations, expansions, dispositions, and facility closures across LKQ's North American portfolio.
- Manage the full transaction lifecycle by coordinating site selection, broker activities, lease negotiations, approvals, documentation, execution, and critical milestones to ensure projects are completed on time and aligned with business objectives.
- Liaise with LKQ's Master Broker (CBRE) and other external partners, driving accountability, mitigating transaction risks, and maintaining visibility into active deal flow.
- Partner with Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Lease Administration, and Business Unit leaders to align real estate decisions with operational, financial, and strategic priorities.
- Maintain and administer real estate systems, including LeaseQuery, Finance360, SharePoint, and other portfolio management tools, ensuring data integrity and accurate portfolio records.
- Monitor lease expirations, critical dates, transaction pipelines, and portfolio activity while providing regular reporting and recommendations to leadership.
- Develop and maintain portfolio reports, dashboards, and executive presentations that support strategic planning, capital forecasting, and real estate decision-making.
- Maintain lease documentation, landlord communications, negotiation summaries, and transaction records while ensuring compliance with internal standards and governance requirements.
- Identify and implement process improvements that enhance transaction execution, reporting, portfolio visibility, and operational efficiency.
- Support strategic real estate initiatives and special projects that optimize LKQ's real estate portfolio and advance the Corporate Real Estate team's objectives.
- Assume other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
- Manage the work of others, including planning, assigning, scheduling and reviewing work, ensures quality standards.  Responsible for hiring, terminating, training and developing, reviewing performance and administering corrective action for staff.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience:
- Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in commercial real estate, transaction management, portfolio management, or lease administration.
- Experience managing multiple real estate transactions simultaneously across a diverse portfolio.
- Strong knowledge of lease administration, commercial leasing practices, and portfolio reporting.

Preferred Requirements:
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
- Experience with Tableau or other reporting tools.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
- Experience working with real estate management systems such as LeaseQuery or similar platforms.
- Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
- Frequent use of Outlook, Word, Excel, graphics, etc. Ability to create, maintain and incorporate functions into Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, databases, and Powerpoint presentations to support business objectives.

jobs.description:

Responsible for supporting an assigned business unit or region by promoting, communicating, and implementing human resources (HR) strategies and initiatives. Build and maintain influential relationships by being a strategic partner with management and an advocate for employees. Collaborate with Corporate HR functions and business leadership to develop and deliver integrated solutions. Essential Job Duties
- Ensure consistent application of HR programs, policies, and practices across the assigned business.
- Provide strategic and operational day-to-day HR leadership and work closely with business segment leadership and employees.
- Improve work relationships, increase employee engagement, productivity, and maximize organizational effectiveness.
- In partnership with the Corporate HR group, create, analyze, and disseminate reports that provide information and/or add value to the business. Leverage data to identify relevant trends and metrics to develop solutions and programs.
- Train business segment leadership on HR-related topics, including but not limited to talent acquisition, onboarding, stay interviews, performance management, sexual harassment, and Company policies and procedures.
- Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, monitor compliance, and mitigate risk related to existing Company policies and location-specific laws/regulations governing employment practices, partnering with the Legal department as needed.
- Consult with leadership and employees to identify, manage, and resolve employee relations matters and complex work-related problems and issues.
- Employ a consistent and systematic approach when conducting timely, effective, thorough, and objective investigations and recommending follow-up actions.
- Assist in the handling of Litigation, EEO and Workers' Compensation case management.
- Provide hands-on support to leadership and employees to better understand and utilize HR tools, processes, and policies.
- Provide guidance, input and support on business unit restructuring, workforce planning, and succession planning.
- Integrate new employees from acquisitions.
- Manage HR Generalist(s) and/or HRBP(s)- set expectations, monitor performance, and provide coaching and feedback to ensure they meet all essential functions of their role for their assigned business unit or region.
